posts.title: ORR proposes monitoring overhaul for care facilities
posts.excerpt: ORR published a November 18 proposal overhauling monitoring and compliance for its care provider facilities, with comments due December 18, 2026. It would create an Advisory Terminations List for…
posts.body: [ORR published a November 18 proposal](https://thefederalregister.org/documents/2026-23460/submission-for-office-of-management-and-budget-review-monitoring-and-compliance-for-office-of-refugee-resettlement-care-) overhauling monitoring and compliance for its care provider facilities, with comments due December 18, 2026. It would create an Advisory Terminations List for staff dismissed over substantiated child-safety allegations, so they cannot move unchecked to another shelter.

posts.title: Salesforce and Microsoft launch Copilotforce
posts.excerpt: Salesforce and Microsoft announced Copilotforce at Microsoft Ignite on November 17, bringing Salesforce customer context and sales actions into Microsoft Copilot in public preview. The Fabric side is…
posts.body: [Salesforce and Microsoft announced Copilotforce](https://www.salesforce.com/in/news/stories/copilotforce-announcement/?bc=OTH) at Microsoft Ignite on November 17, bringing Salesforce customer context and sales actions into Microsoft Copilot in public preview. The Fabric side is the part that is actually live today, with Data Federation generally available so teams can query Microsoft Fabric OneLake data inside Salesforce Data 360 without duplicating datasets.

posts.title: SpaceX says Starbase tax break would steady county revenue
posts.excerpt: SpaceX argued its proposed payments in lieu of taxes would give Cameron County predictable revenue from the Starbase data center. It warned that Texas tax rules can swing rates year to year as the…
posts.body: [SpaceX argued](https://wccftech.com/spacex-breaks-silence-says-10-year-100-tax-abatement-for-24-billion-starbase-data-center-infrastructure-is-necessary-to-avoid-rapid-tax-value-fluctuations/) its proposed payments in lieu of taxes would give Cameron County predictable revenue from the Starbase data center. It warned that Texas tax rules can swing rates year to year as the computing equipment rapidly depreciates, creating a future revenue cliff.

posts.body: [LangChain launched LangSmith Tool Gateway](https://www.langchain.com/blog/langsmith-tool-gateway) in public beta, a managed layer that handles credentials, identity, and access for every agent tool call. posts.title: Pharr launched tuition-free fiber technician training
posts.excerpt: Pharr Connect U is a tuition-free fiber-optic technician program in Pharr, announced December 17, 2025. It plans to prepare 240 trainees for industry-recognized certifications, with paid internships…
posts.body: [Pharr Connect U](https://pharr-tx.gov/city-of-pharr-awarded-4-8-million-to-expand-broadband-workforce-in-south-texas-and-launch-pharr-connect-u/) is a tuition-free fiber-optic technician program in Pharr, announced December 17, 2025. It plans to prepare 240 trainees for industry-recognized certifications, with paid internships and job placement with local broadband employers.

posts.title: PS5 update 14.23 is required to play GTA 6
posts.excerpt: Sony confirmed PS5 players must install firmware 14.23 before playing GTA 6, which launches at midnight on November 19. Updating trades the homebrew path for the game, since newer firmware can cut…
posts.body: [Sony confirmed PS5 players must install firmware 14.23 before playing GTA 6](https://www.firstpost.com/tech/planning-to-play-gta-6-on-ps5-make-sure-you-install-this-mandatory-update-first-14061055.html), which launches at midnight on November 19. Updating trades the homebrew path for the game, since newer firmware can cut off the exploits jailbreaks rely on.

posts.title: Cameron County quashes SpaceX's $24B Starbase tax-break bid
posts.excerpt: Cameron County commissioners voted 3-2 Tuesday against holding a public hearing on SpaceX's request for a 100% property-tax abatement for 10 years on its $24 billion Starbase data center. SpaceX…
posts.body: [Cameron County commissioners voted 3-2 Tuesday](https://wccftech.com/spacexs-tax-break-bid-for-its-24-billion-starbase-data-center-quashed-as-commissioners-vote-against-public-hearing-for-100-10-year-abatement/) against holding a public hearing on SpaceX's request for a 100% property-tax abatement for 10 years on its $24 billion Starbase data center. SpaceX warned it would take future investment outside Cameron County without the break.

posts.title: Microsoft unveils Copilot Workspaces, new AI models at Ignite
posts.excerpt: Copilot Workspaces gives teams and their AI agents one shared space built around shared context. OpenAI's GPT-6.2 also arrives in Microsoft Foundry, alongside Meta's latest models.
posts.body: [Copilot Workspaces](https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/microsoft-rolls-out-agentic-ai-tools-copilot-workspaces-467.htm) gives teams and their AI agents one shared space built around shared context. OpenAI's GPT-6.2 also arrives in Microsoft Foundry, alongside Meta's latest models.

posts.title: Senate draft sets $4.32 billion for ORR refugee account
posts.excerpt: Published Nov 18, 2026, 5:02 PM: The Senate draft Labor-HHS bill puts $4.32 billion into the Refugee & Entrant Assistance account that funds ORR, including services for unaccompanied children. The…
posts.body: Published Nov 18, 2026, 5:02 PM: The [Senate draft Labor-HHS bill](https://cwsglobal.org/blog/daily-state-of-play-trumps-indefinite-refugee-ban-and-funding-halt/) puts $4.32 billion into the Refugee & Entrant Assistance account that funds ORR, including services for unaccompanied children. The draft also adds guardrails to strengthen congressional oversight of services for unaccompanied children.
